synthesizer_contract.inputs: Only the five separately frozen M32 role RAW files.
synthesizer_contract.reconciliation_rule: Resolve by evidence scope, conflict sets, ATMS assumptions/nogoods, invariants/metamorphic tests and falsifiers; never by majority.

reconciliation.issue: Historical P0 structure is coherent but current semantic/current-universe certification is incomplete.
reconciliation.resolution: Preserve P0 as historical evidence; current governed attestation remains separate.

reconciliation.issue: Hash comparator outcomes change under representation substitution.
reconciliation.resolution: Treat empirical matches as representation-dependent until canonical serialization is proven.

reconciliation.issue: Performance partitions reconcile but causal interpretation is unproven.
reconciliation.resolution: Retain descriptive timing only; performance remains NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE.

reconciliation.issue: Recorded identity/component fields differ but material independence is unproven.
reconciliation.resolution: Retain field-level separation only; require execution provenance.

reconciliation.issue: Existing evidence surfaces reduce the need for intervention.
reconciliation.resolution: Prefer reuse-first verification; no runtime repair or duplicate deletion.

integrated_findings.claim: Historical caller/trigger sets reconcile structurally; all frozen caller and trigger identities remain resolvable.
Hash equality is representation-sensitive and current semantic equivalence is not certified.
Bounded current selector differs materially from P0 and is not a closed-world runtime universe.
Performance metrics are descriptive but not causally attributable.
Material authority independence and historical provenance are not fully attested.
Existing evidence surfaces support reuse-first verification and do not justify runtime repair.

barinel.reason: No justified priors or executable spectra across cross-role hypotheses.

ranked.query: Authorized current manifest with universe predicate, canonical hash method and active-entry mapping.
Canonical authority + material Curator/Validator execution provenance.
Controlled matched performance replay after timing semantics are fixed.

assumptions.text: P0 is historical evidence, not current certification.
Hash comparator is empirical until canonical historical serialization is demonstrated.
Pattern/static inventories are discovery surfaces, not authoritative runtime universes.
Recorded identity inequality is weaker than material execution independence.
Timing semantics and matched intervention boundaries are prerequisites for causal performance inference.
Existing safe evidence surfaces should be reused before adding runtime mechanisms.

Authoritative current universe materially differs from bounded scan/P0.
Recorded labels map to one effective execution principal/session.
Existing evidence surfaces cannot safely close gaps.

propagation.result: Retain object resolution; downgrade drift semantics to UNKNOWN.
Recompute current coverage from authoritative manifest.
Escalate authority risk and remove independence support.

C.solver_reason: Implemented checks were SQL set/partition/metamorphic invariants; no compatible QED/VeriEQL/SMT verifier was required.
cross_role_metamorphic_results: Hash comparator substitution changes equality outcome.
Additive timing assumption fails on most chunks.
Identity-label reduction cannot prove material independence.
Frozen P0 selector and bounded current pattern selector are not interchangeable.

E.rationale: No material runtime defect is demonstrated, but current semantic equivalence, current-universe totality and material authority remain unclosed; performance remains NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE.
potential_falsifiers: Canonical current manifest closes semantic/coverage gaps.
Controlled matched replay proves or excludes material performance regression.

reversal_criteria.to_REPAIR_REQUIRED: Governed verification proves a material active defect.
reversal_criteria.to_NO_ACTION_SUPPORTED: All material unknowns close without defect.
reversal_criteria.to_NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE: Required governed evidence remains inaccessible or ambiguous.

constraints_preserved: Five role RAWs frozen before synthesis
